goal: Implement general Orbit AI conversation that can answer normally when no tool call is needed while preserving context.

success_criteria.description: The Orbit AI router distinguishes ordinary conversation from follow-up, contact, event, calendar, and to-do intents using explicit decision output that tests can inspect.
General conversation prompts receive generated assistant replies that preserve recent context and do not invoke tools when the prompt has no tool-worthy intent.

Ten named evaluation cases cover greeting, preference memory, clarification, refusal of unsafe side effects, bilingual context, pronoun reference, follow-up continuation, event continuation, off-topic small talk, and no-tool boundary.
GET /app/agent displays ordinary assistant turns without opening a stale tool result panel, while preserving the conversation history needed by the next turn.
The feature documentation records the design-evaluation-analysis loop and the acceptance threshold for no-tool and context-memory correctness.

out_of_scope: Adding external messaging or notification sends
Replacing specialized Orbit AI tool flows
